display.title: Rabbi Akiva and the Mitzvah That Saved His Life (Story Preview)
display.summary_short: A short preview: Rabbi Akiva, jailed for teaching Torah, does a special mitzvah in prison that so amazes the ruler that he frees him and makes him his advisor.
display.summary_long: A brief story introduction from the Tzivos Hashem radio show. Uncle Yossi sets the scene for a story about Rabbi Akiva: in his time, learning and teaching Torah was forbidden and severely punished, yet Rabbi Akiva trusted in Hashem and kept teaching in public, and he was often arrested. The ruler of the land, always looking for a wise advisor, first noticed Rabbi Akiva's greatness while he was a prisoner, when he saw him doing a very special mitzvah. Because of that unusual sight, the ruler freed him and invited him to the palace. The clip ends before the story itself, which tells what the mitzvah was.
